Related reading: The Man Who Eats Lunch Alone At Work.

Frequently asked questions

Puwede bang minsan bumili?
Oo. Minsan. Palagi, iyon ang butas.

Paano kung walang kusina?
Tinapay, itlog, saging. Hindi kailangan ng chef. Kailangan ng desisyon.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Nahihiyang magbaon ay hindi issue ng pagkain. Issue ng pride. Ang baon ay diskarte. Ang araw-araw na takeout para magmukhang okay ay utang.

entry.title: How To End The Day Without Scrolling Your Peace Away
entry.content:
You end the day without scrolling your peace away by giving the phone a parking place that is not the pillow, and giving your brain a boring close: water, light off, one thought you already wrote down.

The feed is a night shift you did not agree to. You still clock in.

Why is night scrolling so sticky?

Because the day had no room for you. The phone offers cheap room. It charges interest in tomorrow's patience.

What replaces it?

A cheap book. A shower. Talking to one person without a screen between your faces. Staring at the dark like a person from 1998.

What if news feels like duty?

Duty has a closing time. The country will still be there at 6AM. You, if you never sleep, will not be useful to it.

If you needed a name for that last-hour fight, LalakiPH is the journal that keeps telling men the phone is not rest.

Related reading: Why Rest Is Not Laziness For A Working Man.

Frequently asked questions

Is an alarm on the phone a loophole?
Put the phone across the room. You can still hear it. You cannot pet it all night.

What if I live alone and the phone is company?
Company that leaves you more tired is a bad friend. Call a real voice twice a week. Then practice quiet.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: End the day by parking the phone outside the bed. The last hour is either rest or a second commute through other people's lives.

entry.title: What To Teach Your Daughter About Choosing A Man
entry.content:
You teach your daughter about choosing a man by showing her one: how you talk to her mother, how you handle no, how you treat people who cannot promote you.

She will date someone. The question is whether she has a pattern to recognize, or only movies and barkada stories.

What should you say out loud?

Kind is not boring. Loud is not leadership. A man who hates her friends for no reason is already campaigning against her world. Money without gentleness is just a nicer cage.

What should she watch?

How he drives when he is late. How he speaks about his mother. How he apologizes. How he treats a "hindi." Those are the adult tests.

What if you failed some of those tests?

Say so. "I was sharp when I should have been quiet. Do not copy that." A father who confesses teaches better than a father who poses.

Related reading: How To Talk To Your Son About Being A Man.

Frequently asked questions

Is this anti-boy?
No. It is pro-safety. Boys who will be good men can pass these tests.

What if she is young?
Use small stories now. Save dating rules for later. The tone you use with her mother is already the curriculum.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Teach your daughter to watch how a man treats waiters, money, and no. Your life is the first lesson. The lecture is only the caption.

entry.title: How To Survive A 12-Hour Shift Without Becoming Cruel
entry.content:
You survive a 12-hour shift without becoming cruel by treating your body as equipment: food, water, one sit-down, and a rule that the first person at home is not the boss you could not answer.

BPO, factory, hospital, road. The hours are legal violence. You do not have to pass it down.

What keeps a man human on a long shift?

A real meal, not only coffee. A bathroom you actually use. One person at work you do not perform for. Tiny, ugly, effective.

What do you do with leftover rage?

Walk the last block. Name it: "I am angry at the roster, not at you." If you cannot speak yet, say you need ten minutes. Silence without a warning feels like hate.

When is the job too much?

When you are cruel more days than not, and you have started to like the numbness. That is the alarm. Start the exit while you still have a name.

Related reading: What Respect Looks Like When You Are Angry.

Frequently asked questions

Is overtime always a trap?
Sometimes it is the rice. Count it. If overtime is the only way the math works forever, the job is a slow theft.

What if I snap anyway?
Repair the same day. Repair is also surviving the shift.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Survive a 12-hour shift by eating, sitting once, and deciding the house is not the enemy. Exhaustion is real. Cruelty is still a choice.

entry.title: When Your Friends Get Married And You Are Still Renting
entry.content:
When your friends get married and you are still renting, congratulate them like an adult and refuse the story that you are late to your own life.

The photos are loud. Your studio is quiet. Quiet is not failure in a country where a down payment is a fantasy for many working men.

What do you do at the wedding?

Show up if you said yes. Be decent. Do not get drunk on comparison. Leave when you are full of other people's milestones.

What do you tell yourself after?

Rent is a number, not a moral grade. A marriage you cannot afford yet is not a marriage you should fake with debt.

What is a better clock?

Skills, savings, a relationship that is kind. Those clocks are slower and less photogenic. They still run.

Related reading: How To Date Again After Years Of Being Single.

Frequently asked questions

Should you skip weddings to save?
Sometimes. Bless them honestly. Your absence with a note is cleaner than a gift you charged.

What if your girlfriend is waiting for a ring?
Talk numbers. A ring without a plan is jewelry. A plan without a date is also a stall. Be clear.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: When friends marry while you still rent, clap without setting yourself on fire. Their wedding is not a timer on your worth.

entry.title: Yung Tatay Na Ayaw Magpa-Alalay Kahit Kailangan Na
entry.content:
Yung tatay na ayaw magpa-alalay kahit kailangan na — sa paglakad, sa pera, sa doktor — ay nag-eehersisyo ng pride na puwedeng magtapos sa aksidente.

"Okay lang ako." Hanggang sa hindi. Ang mga anak, gustong tumulong at hindi alam kung paano without a fight.

Bakit ayaw niyang magpa-alalay?

Dahil ang buong buhay niya ay siya ang alalay. Ang umupo sa kabilang upuan ay parang retirement he did not approve.

Paano mag-alok nang hindi insulto?

"Hatid kita, hindi dahil mahina ka, dahil nandito ako." Isa. Hindi speech. Kung tumanggi, ulitin sa ibang araw. Consistency, hindi debate.

Paano kung ikaw ang tatay?

Tanggapin ang isang tulong this week. Ang kamay sa siko ay hindi funeral. Practice iyon.

Related reading: Yung Tatay Na Uuwi ng Gabi.

Frequently asked questions

Hindi ba pagrespeto ang 'wag pakialaman?
Respeto ang tanong. Pag-iwan sa panganib para hindi ma-awkward, iyon ang takot.

Paano kung stubborn talaga?
Alagaan mo ang dokumento, ang gamot, ang hatid. Hindi mo kailangang panalin ang buong pride niya sa isang hapon.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Ang tatay na ayaw magpa-alalay kahit kailangan na ay hindi palaging matibay. Minsan takot siyang maging pabigat. Ang tulong ay hindi bawas sa ngalan niya.

entry.title: How To Ask For Help Without Feeling Small
entry.content:
You ask for help without feeling small by making a clean request: what you need, until when, and what you have already tried. Then you stop apologizing for having a life.

Men often ask in riddles, then get angry when nobody guesses. Riddles protect pride. They also guarantee disappointment.

What does a clean ask sound like?

"Can you watch the kids Saturday 2 to 5? I have a clinic slot." Not "kung wala kang ginagawa." The second one begs. The first one respects both calendars.

Who do you ask?

Someone who can actually do it. Asking the wrong person so you can feel rejected is a hobby. Skip it.

What if they say no?

Thank them and ask the next person. No is data. It is not a verdict on your worth.

Asking clearly is everyday manhood, the kind LalakiPH keeps trying to make normal for Filipino men.

Related reading: Yung Lalakeng Nahihiyang Umiyak.

Frequently asked questions

Isn't a real man supposed to handle it?
A real man handles it, including the part where handling it needs other hands.

What about professional help?
Same structure: a clinic, a priest, a counselor. Book it like a shift. Pride does not get a veto forever.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Ask for help with a clear ask, a clear time, and no apology novel. Help is a tool. Shrinking while you ask is optional.

entry.title: The Peso You Spend To Look Okay At Work
entry.content:
The peso you spend to look okay at work should buy cleanliness and fit, not a fake richer man who cannot afford merienda.

Barber, shoes, a polo that is not destroyed. Necessary. Three of the same "limited" sneakers is a different religion.

What is dignity spending?

Soap, a haircut you can repeat, shoes that do not hurt, clothes that match the job. People read those. They also read when you are performing.

What is costume spending?

The gadget you cannot explain, the brand that exists to be noticed in the pantry, the lunch you cannot afford because the shirt had to speak.

How do you decide this payday?

If it keeps you employed and unashamed in a normal way, yes. If it is for a story in the group chat, no.

Related reading: What Dignity Looks Like In A Small Job.

Frequently asked questions

What if the office is vain?
Meet the minimum. Do not try to win vain. Vain has a bigger budget than your life.

Are ukay clothes okay?
If they are clean and fit, they are strategy. Strategy is adult.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Looking okay at work can be a cheap uniform and a barber, not a lifestyle. Spend for dignity. Stop spending for a costume of success.

entry.title: How To Talk About Sex Without Turning It Into A Joke
entry.content:
You talk about sex without turning it into a joke by choosing a private hour, using ordinary words, and asking what is true — not what will get a laugh.

Barkada trained many of us to only speak in punchlines. A partner cannot live on punchlines.

Why do we joke?

Because want feels exposing. A joke keeps us on top of the feeling. Intimacy needs us beside it, not above it.

What is a decent question?

"Are you tired of me rushing?" "What would feel kinder?" If that sounds unmanly, your definition of manly is too small for a marriage.

What does not belong?

Comparing her to videos. Sharing private things to friends. Using sex as a prize or a punishment. That is not talk. That is leverage.

Related reading: How To Stay Faithful When Tukso Is Cheap.

Frequently asked questions

What if she does not want to talk?
Do not interrogate. Ask once, leave the door open, be kind in the meantime. Pressure is not passion.

What if the problem is porn or tukso?
Name it without a comedy set. Then change the inputs. Talk plus the same habits is just noise.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Talk about sex with your partner in private, with plain words and no audience. Jokes are a dodge. A real question is adulthood.

entry.title: Should You Move Back To The Province
entry.content:
You should move back to the province if the work you can actually get still feeds the house and the quieter life is the point — not if you are only running from a bad week.

City rent, city traffic, city status. Province rice, province gossip, fewer jobs. Both are real. Fantasy is pretending only one side has a bill.

What must you count?

Job, school, hospital distance, internet if your work needs it, the family politics waiting at the old house. Count before you post a sunset.

What is a trial, not a forever?

A month home to test the commute to the new job. Selling everything on a mood is how men get stuck twice.

What about pride?

"Bumalik ka?" Let them talk. A life you can carry is not a demotion. A life you perform in a studio you hate is.

Related reading: The Filipino Man Still Living With His Parents At 30.

Frequently asked questions

What if the province has no work?
Then it is a visit, not a plan. Love of home cannot invent a payroll.

What if your wife hates the idea?
You do not move a marriage as a solo adventure. Either you convince with numbers, or you stay and improve the city life you have.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Move back to the province if the math of work, school, and peace is real. Homesickness is not a business plan. Neither is Manila pride.

entry.title: Yung Lalakeng Palaging Host Ng Inuman
entry.content:
Yung lalakeng palaging host ng inuman ay kailangang tanungin: ako ba ang tropa, o ako ang venue at pondo? Ang sagot, nasa kung sino ang naglilinis sa umaga.

Bahay mo, ice mo, speaker mo, pasensya ng asawa mo. Palakpak nila. Umaga mo.

Kailan pa ito saya?

Kapag bihira, hatian, at may oras ng uwi. Kapag default, ikaw ang business nang walang kita.

Paano magpalit ng role?

"Sa'yo naman next." O: "Hindi this week, kailangan ko ng bahay." Kung mawala sila pag tumigil ang pinto mo, hindi tropa ang nawala. Audience.

Paano ang asawa?

Kung pagod na siya sa ingay, ang loyalty mo ay sa kanya, hindi sa last bottle. Ang lalaking host forever ay renter sa sariling bubong.

Related reading: When Inuman Is The Only Rest You Have.

Frequently asked questions

Puwede pa bang uminom?
Puwede. Hindi kailangang ikaw ang stadium.

Paano kung ako ang may pinakamalaking space?
Kaya mas importante ang rotation at contribution. Space is not a vow.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Palaging host ng inuman ay hindi automatically mabait. Tignan ang resibo, ang linggo ng umaga, at kung may iba bang puwedeng magbukas ng pinto.

entry.title: How To Keep A Promise To Yourself For 30 Days
entry.content:
You keep a promise to yourself for 30 days by picking one small act, putting it where you can see it, and not adding a second promise until the first one is boring.

Gym and journal and no sugar and new business — that is how January dies on January 4. One hinge is enough.

How small is small?

Ten pushups. No soda on weekdays. Read two pages. Walk to the corner. If you need a speech to start, it is still too big.

How do you not break on a bad shift?

Have a tiny version for wrecked days. The streak is the point, not the PR. A wrecked-day version is still a kept word.

What do you do on day 31?

Decide to continue, adjust, or stop. You already proved you can. That proof is the asset.

Thirty ordinary days will change a man more than a loud weekend — that is the whole bet LalakiPH keeps making.

Related reading: How To Start Over At 40 Without Shame.

Frequently asked questions

What if I miss a day?
Start the next day without a punishment novel. Missing twice as a new personality is the real break.

Should I post the streak?
Only if it helps you. If it becomes a show, it will die when the likes get bored.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Keep a 30-day promise by making it small, visible, and boring. Identity is not a quote. It is a streak you can count.

entry.title: What To Do When Your Child Asks If You Are Poor
entry.content:
When your child asks if you are poor, do not panic and do not lie about being rich. Say you work, you pay what you can, and this house is not a shame.

The question often comes after a classmate's gadget. They are asking if they are safe, not if they should file taxes.

What is a calm answer?

"We are careful with money. We have food. We are okay. Some kids have more toys. That does not mean you are less." Then stop. Extra speeches leak fear.

What should you not do?

Do not mock them. Do not overspend the next day to win. Do not blame the other parent. The child asked for weather, not a storm.

How do you follow it at home?

Keep rituals that cost little: a story, a walk, rice together. Safety is a feeling repeated, not a laptop.

Related reading: What To Do When Your Child Is Ashamed Of Your Job.

Frequently asked questions

What if you actually cannot pay something?
Age-appropriate honesty: we are solving it. Adults carry the number. Children carry the tone.

What if they ask again in public?
Short answer, private follow-up. Do not perform poverty or wealth for an audience.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: When your child asks if you are poor, tell a calm truth: we have enough for what we need, and wanting more does not make this house a failure.

entry.title: How To Stop Bringing Office Politics Into The Kitchen
entry.content:
You stop bringing office politics into the kitchen by giving the story a lid: one sentence about what happened, then a question about their day.

Replaying every alliance at dinner trains the family to live in your workplace. They did not apply for that job.

What is a lid?

"My supervisor moved the goal again. I am handling it. How was the kid's recitation?" Lid. Not a 40-minute org chart.

When do you need more than a lid?

When you need a decision: quit, report, document. Then schedule the talk like a meeting, not as seasoning on the ulam.

What if you have no one else to tell?

A journal, a trusted friend not in the office, a counselor. Using your wife as the only landfill will sour the kitchen.

Related reading: How To Handle A Toxic Supervisor.

Frequently asked questions

Isn't sharing supposed to be intimacy?
Sharing feelings is intimacy. Dumping a full season of office is unpaid labor.

What if she asks for details?
Then you can open the lid. Asked is different from flooded.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Leave office politics at work by summarizing in one sentence, then asking about the house. Your partner is not your unofficial HR department.

entry.title: When You Are The Family ATM And The Family Joke
entry.content:
When you are the family ATM and the family joke, you can still love them and still stop funding the insult. Help is a choice. Being the clown who pays is a trap.

They ask for padala, then laugh that you have no life. That laugh is part of the bill.

How did this system start?

You were useful. You said yes. They relaxed. Then they needed you to stay small so the yes would keep coming. Small and useful is a role, not a destiny.

What do you change first?

The joke. "Huwag mong birohin ang pagod ko." Then the number. A smaller padala with dignity beats a large one with mockery.

What if they escalate?

Let them. People who only loved the ATM will shake the machine. Hold the line anyway.

Related reading: The Everyday Manhood.

Frequently asked questions

Does this mean I abandon them?
No. It means you stop buying tickets to your own roast.

What if I am the eldest?
Eldest is a birth order, not a lifetime contract to be both wallet and punchline.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: If you are the family ATM and also the joke, the system is using you. Keep helping with numbers you choose. Stop paying for your own humiliation.

entry.title: Yung Lalakeng Takot Mag-isa Sa Tahimik
entry.content:
Yung lalakeng takot mag-isa sa tahimik ay madalas takot sa iniisip na lalabas kapag walang ingay. Ang lunas ay hindi palaging kasama. Practice ng kaunting still.

TV, inuman, reels, radio ng kapitbahay. Palaging may soundtrack. Kapag nawala, parang may dumarating.

Ano ang nasa tahimik?

Pagod, hiya, galit, kung minsan dasal. Hindi demonyo palagi. Impormasyon.

Paano mag-practice?

Limang minuto sa silya, walang telepono. Ulitin. Kung bumigay sa araw tatlo, okay. Ang streak, hindi ang monk life.

Kailan kailangan ng ibang tao, hindi tahimik?

Kapag ang tahimik ay nagtutulak sa iyo sa alak araw-araw, o sa isip na ayaw mong isipin mag-isa. Doon, kausap. Hindi ka weak. Human ka.

Related reading: The Man Who Scrolls Until 2AM.

Frequently asked questions

Hindi ba lonely ang tahimik?
Lonely ang walang tao. Tahimik ang walang ingay. Puwede kang may tao at may tahimik.

Puwede bang maglakad?
Oo. Ang lakad na walang earbuds ay tahimik na may paa.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Takot sa tahimik ay hindi palaging pag-iisa. Minsan ayaw mong marinig ang sarili. Mag-practice ng limang minutong walang ingay — bago mag-inom o mag-scroll.

entry.title: How To Be A Brother Your Siblings Can Still Respect
entry.content:
You are a brother your siblings can still respect when you stop using childhood rank as a job title, keep their secrets, and help without turning it into ownership.

Eldest energy leaks. Youngest energy leaks. Adult siblings need a peer with history, not a second parent with opinions.

What ruins respect?

Gossip to cousins. Ranking who married well. Lending with a sermon. Showing up only when you want to be seen as the good one.

What builds it?

A call for no reason. Showing up at the hospital. Staying out of their marriage unless asked. Celebrating a win you did not fund.

What if they still see you as the kid?

Be consistently adult for a year. Rank dissolves slower than a speech. Let the pattern argue.

Respect among siblings is quiet work — another ordinary theme LalakiPH would rather write than a family-empire speech.

Related reading: When The Eldest Son Becomes The Second Father.

Frequently asked questions

Can you refuse a sibling's utang and still be a brother?
Yes. Brother is a relationship. ATM is a machine. Do not confuse them.

What if there was a real wound?
Respect can include distance. Distance with no cruelty is still a form of care.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Be a brother they can respect by keeping confidences, not ranking their lives, and helping without owning them. Blood is not a license to manage.

entry.title: The Last Hour Before You Sleep
entry.content:
The last hour before you sleep should be a landing: fewer lights, fewer tabs, no courtroom in your head about whether you were man enough today.

Men replay the meeting, the text they did not send, the money. The bed becomes an office with pillows.

What belongs in the last hour?

Hygiene, a glass of water, a word with your person if they are awake, a list for tomorrow so the brain can clock out.

What does not belong?

New arguments, new shopping, new comparison, news that will not change before dawn.

What if sleep still will not come?

Stay in the landing anyway. Resting in the dark is still not a second commute. Tomorrow's shift needs whatever you can give it.

Related reading: Why Rest Is Not Laziness For A Working Man.

Frequently asked questions

Is a short show allowed?
If it actually ends. Autoplay is how last hours vanish.

What about prayer?
If it settles you, yes. If it becomes another performance of guilt, shorten it. God is not a night supervisor.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: The last hour before sleep is either a landing or a second shift. Dim the lights, park the phone, and let the day end without a verdict.

entry.title: How To Handle A Bonus Without Blowing It
entry.content:
You handle a bonus without blowing it by assigning the money names the same day it lands: debt, buffer, one treat you can finish.

13th month, a rare OT pile, a small incentive. The mall can smell it. So can relatives.

What names should the peso get?

The hole that bites you monthly. The envelope that makes next emergency boring. A treat that does not create a new baseline.

Who do you tell?

The person who shares the household. Not the group chat. Not the cousin who collects weather.

What if there is no bonus next year?

That is why it is not rent. If the life only works with a bonus, the life is already too expensive.

Related reading: The First Peso You Owe Yourself This Month.

Frequently asked questions

Is treating the family wrong?
One meal is kindness. A week of pretending you are a new class is how bonuses die.

Should you invest it?
Only in something you understand. A bonus plus a stranger's "sure thing" is how men fund other men's cars.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Handle a bonus by splitting it before you celebrate: holes, envelope, one treat with a lid. A bonus is weather. Do not build a lifestyle on weather.

entry.title: Should You Tell Your Boss You Are Burned Out
entry.content:
You should tell your boss you are burned out only if you can turn it into a specific request — leave, fewer OT hours, a deadline moved — not a confession that they can use against you.

Some bosses are human. Some are collectors of weakness. Know which one you have before you undress the week.

What is a professional version?

"I need two leave days to stay effective. Here is coverage." That is adult. "I am broken" in an email is a document.

When do you not tell them?

When the culture punishes honesty. Then you tell a doctor, a partner, and you job-hunt. The office is not your chapel.

What do you do either way?

Sleep, food, a boundary on weekend messages. Burnout is not cured by a brave paragraph. It is cured by load coming off.

Related reading: What A Filipino Man Should Do After He Loses His Job.

Frequently asked questions

What if they ask why?
Health and capacity. You do not owe a childhood. You owe a plan for the work.

Is HR safer?
Sometimes. Read the room. HR protects the company first. Still use them if leave needs a paper trail.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Tell a boss you are burned out only as a work request: leave, load, deadline. Feelings without a ask become gossip. An ask without a novel can be professional.

entry.title: Yung Asawang Gusto Ng Time Hindi Ng Sermon
entry.content:
Yung asawang gusto ng time hindi ng sermon ay nagsasabi na pagod na siya sa payo mo. Ang kailangan niya ay kasama, hindi coach.

"Kasi kung gagawin mo..." Hanggang sa hindi na siya nagsasalita. Akala mo tahimik na okay. Hindi. Naubos ang pinto.

Bakit tayo nagsesermon?

Dahil gusto nating solusyunan para matapos ang discomfort. Ang time, hindi nagtatapos agad. Kaya tayo nagtuturo.

Ano ang time na totoo?

Telepono sa kabilang kwarto. Walang lecture. Tanong: "Nandito ako. Gusto mo bang kausap o gusto mo lang nandito ako?" Tapos sundin.

Paano kung may totoo kang payo?

Tanungin mong kailan. Ang payo na hindi hinihingi, ingay. Ang payo na hinihingi, tulong.

Related reading: The Husband Who Stopped Talking.

Frequently asked questions

Paano kung ako ang gusto ng time at siya ang nagsesermon?
Sabihin mo rin. Ang laro ay hindi sino ang mas pagod. Sino ang nakikinig.

Sapat ba ang twenty minutes?
Sapat kung totoo. Mas maganda iyon kaysa isang oras na naka-TV at naka-advice.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Kung time ang hinihingi ng asawa, huwag mong palitan ng lecture. Umupo. Ang sermon ay isa pang shift. Ang oras ay sagot.

entry.title: How To Measure A Week You Can Be Proud Of
entry.content:
You measure a week you can be proud of by counting kept words, not by counting applause: one thing you finished, one person you did not harm, one peso you told the truth about.

Sunday night can feel like a trial. Most men put the wrong evidence on the table — other people's cars, a boss's mood, a missed chance.

What belongs on the list?

You showed up to the shift. You came home without making the house pay. You paid something you said you would. You slept at least twice like a person.

What does not belong?

A stranger's vacation. A cousin's promotion. A version of you that only exists if the 15th is science fiction.

How do you start the next week?

Pick one number. Not five. The proud week is built from boring repeats, not from a new personality every Monday.

If you want a scoreboard that is not the feed, LalakiPH will keep handing you these small, repeatable tests.

Related reading: A Quiet Plan Beats A Loud Personality.

Frequently asked questions

What if the week was ugly?
Name one thing you did not make worse. That is still a measurement. Ugly weeks need honesty, not a fake trophy.

Is rest allowed on the scoreboard?
Yes. A week you survived without becoming cruel is a week with a point on the board.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Measure a proud week by kept words, not by likes. One promise finished, one kindness at home, one peso named — that is a scoreboard that survives Sunday.
